result.summary: The image depicts a low-density residential street with a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer. While the environment is relatively low-speed, it lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or ADA-compliant curb ramps at transition points.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection of the sidewalk and the driveway/side street area, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left where the sidewalk meets the asphalt area

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the sidewalk terminus creates an accessibility barrier for users with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk near the driveway transition

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees and mature landscaping near the roadway may partially obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the pedestrian network is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks separated from the roadway by a grass buffer, providing good longitudinal separation for pedestrians. However, the environment lacks marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic calming measures, and the wide, unmarked roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and the overall width of the street can lead to higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Designated Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signage to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and absence of visible traffic control measures create an environment where pedestrians must cross without designated protection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to designate pedestrian crossing areas at the intersection.

hazards.name: Absence of curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions makes the intersection inaccessible for users with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled intersection
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle movement at the crossing point.

interventions.title: Install high-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Construct ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps at all four corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Implement traffic calming
interventions.description: Add stop signs or speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds through the residential area.

result.summary: The image shows a wide residential street that is highly hostile to pedestrians due to a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings. The roadway surface is in poor condition with extensive cracking and patching, and the absence of lane markings creates an undefined and potentially high-speed environment for vehicles.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway alongside vehicles because there are no paved walkways.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the main roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks any markings or signage to designate pedestrian right-of-way or safe crossing points.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching create trip hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve unexpectedly.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to define the travel way and use curb extensions or paint to narrow the perceived width of the road, slowing traffic.
